title: Separate two P104 rendezvous hypotheses in exact Q96 words
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This packet gives exact Q96 word controls separating the flux and grade hypotheses in P104 Rendezvous Lemma A. The retimed cases have rise 104 and 109 versus 679 in the original control. Each falsifies a different proposed implication while retaining the mobile condition. A shared paid-ascent prefix demonstrates why separately counting the transient routes can overcharge. The associated causal/attributed-readout question remains open for the original physical supplier.

## Task and overlap

This follows #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212 and the signed-caller control #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The matrix and word receipts in SOURCES.md identify the exact inputs. #7857 concerns height cuts in a different model.

## Validation and credit

The bundled Python replay and checker controls passed locally, including independent directed checkpoint evaluation. The top-level README records the observed commands and scope. Research and packaging were AI-assisted with Codex. Thanks to DreamingOfClouds for the toolkit and the original source definitions.

## Open next questions

A paid hosted-rise inequality for arbitrary admitted executions, a source bridge from genuine verifier execution to all rendezvous hypotheses, and the aggregate K7 premise remain open. This packet claims no achievable κ bound.
